title: (OPT) Eliminate duplicate imported cache-key directories while preserving cold/warm graph parity
body:
# Cached graph parity: owning-key directory inside canonical core receipt

Current source checkpoint: d6d483adf. No executable rerun; the immutable aa775 receipts below establish the observed failures.

Observed row-loan owner owning-selected-15.log: checked-cold core 20,932,840 versus ordinary and checked-warm 20,930,376. Exact stage difference is FrontendRetention +2,464; selective/fresh resolutions differ only in stage label, not sum. Mixed-byte owner 16: +3,696 at FrontendRetention. All full JSON fields agree except budget.used_builder_bytes and the digest that includes it. These are actual imported AST Function directory requests, not evidence of initial LoanPlan staging differences.

Source chain:
- src/workspace_graph/expected_projection/borrowed_leaf/checked_key.rs:9-44: current borrowed imported key materialization acquires combined authored+generated Function and type directories, clones authored payloads and moves generated roots.
- Same module:59-77: combined_directory reserves count * sizeof(T), then allocates Vec::with_capacity(count); this is real extra storage while the generated root directory remains live.
- src/workspace_graph.rs:4430-4473: non-hit resolver consumption is recorded before FrontendRetention/into_checked_key; the publication request remains in the same core ledger.
- src/workspace_graph.rs:4397-4427: warm hits charge actual revalidation plus retained original resolver and loan-capacity residual; there is no owning key materialization.
- src/workspace_graph.rs:4110-4137 and 4206: actual maximum core consumption is folded into the graph budget and digest.

Owning contract tension:
- docs/WORKSPACE-SEMANTIC-GRAPH-V1.md:161-163 defines used_builder_bytes=max(canonical_phase_bytes, core_phase_consumed_bytes).
- That specification:332-335 explicitly requires cache publication paying combined directories; it currently excludes a shared authored AST cache.
- docs/PROJECT-FRONTEND-CACHE-V1.md:126 and docs/PROJECT-SEMANTIC-CACHE-V1.md:81-96 retain ordinary cold graph/Image byte equality and actual loan accounting.

A larger source representation correction can own authored AST and generated overlays as separate immutable directories. It must not borrow the build-local programme or accept a cache/source association merely because two values have equal bytes. Current source and imported provider replay remain mandatory. The previous-source receiver must use an explicit compiler-held ProgramSource view; snapshot encoding must emit exactly the canonical historical field/order concatenation without allocating a flattened directory, and restoration must independently authenticate current source/provider association and capacity facts. No report stripping, counter equalization, warm padding, quotas, or test expectations may change.

Required independent controls: original full row-loan, mixed-byte, String-transfer, CopyDiscard, stale-import and lifecycle cold/warm graph/Image equality; exact per-stage debit attribution on the same live ledger; saved owning key/full resolver oracle; complete snapshot byte parity and hostile source/provider/alias/identity drift; genuine selective unchanged-helper reuse on main edit; current full HIR/loan/cleanup/capacity replay; all constructor/refusal/publication/Drop lifetimes and actual allocation observer; no combined second Function/type directory in the new split route. Lifecycle's opposite-signed 1,848-byte receipt still requires separate actual phase attribution before claiming this correction explains it.
